name: @argszero/dsh-human-request-last
description: Keeps the human's words last in every step that carries them. Every step's batch mixes the user's own message with harness-injected `user`-role context (runtime-context, time-context, skill-catalog, agent-instructions), distinguished only by `source.kind`; on an OpenAI-compatible route that maps every non-assistant message to `role: 'user'`, a small local model takes the last of them as the request and answers the timestamp instead of the task (discussion #10080, gpt-oss:20b and qwen3:8b on Ollama). This plugin listens to `agent/pre-step` with `prepend`, so it reads the fully composed batch, and moves injected context ahead of the human message, preserving each group's order. The rewrite is durable: the loop appends the batch in the order returned, so the log records it too. A step with no human message or no injected message is left untouched. Zero runtime dependencies, no core change.
